newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Senate panel clears budget for vote.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Senate panel clears budget for vote.

text.p: The Senate Budget Committee Friday formally cleared for vote in the Senate next week the package of spending cuts called for in the balanced budget agreement with the White House.

A total of $135.9 billion will be cut through 2002 from federal programs, the bulk of which will come from changes n the Medicare and Medicaid health programs for the elderly and poor. Senate debate will begin Monday.
The panel approved the package 18-3. Chairman Pete Domenici, R-New Mexico, said that beyond the cuts the budget makes changes necessary to keep programs solvent beyond 2002.
